rationale: Agreement between authenticated copies of one score entry does not establish that specifications were drafted without bidder-specific influence. The mapping explicitly excludes specification evidence and supplies no unresolved empirical relation that would warrant this claim.

signal_basis.exact_text: Both authenticated independent copies contain the same examined score, and neither contains an intervening alteration.
No other scores, drafting records, contact records or intent evidence is supplied.
The fragment contains no evidence about other entries, specifications, contacts or intentions; matching copies do not certify every stage of the award.
